responsibility: This file provides the out-of-line support data and helper routines shared by GCC’s generic hash_table template. It defines the prime/inverse table used for sizing and probing, implements selection of the next suitable table size, supplies the lazily initialized memory-usage tracker and statistics dumper for hash_table/hash_map/hash_set allocations, and emits the runtime checking failure used when hash/equality trait implementations are inconsistent.
same_name_distinction: Supplies out-of-line support for the hash_table templates—prime-size tables, size-selection helper, lazily initialized memory/statistics support, and the runtime checking failure routine—while gcc/hash-table.h contains the generic hash_table implementation itself.
